mapper.insert: insert into user_profile(user_id, real_name, age, gender, height, weight, avatar) values(#{userId}, #{realName}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{avatar})
mapper.update: update user_profile set real_name = #{realName}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, avatar = #{avatar} where user_id = #{userId}
